photos.file: Cretaceous Footprints Found on Goddard Campus (GSFC 20171208 Archive e001695).jpg
photos.desc: About 110 million light years away, the bright, barred spiral galaxy NGC3259 was just forming stars in dark bands of dust and gas. On Earth, a plant-eating dinosaur left footprints in the Cretaceous m
